articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the period ended June 30, 2022. For the three months ended June 30, 2022 and 2021, Net Income was $41.9 million, or $0.62 per diluted share, compared to Net Income of $1.5 million, or $0.02 per diluted share, respectively. articles.title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Reports 2022 Second Quarter Results
